run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T01:56:03Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is firing because the product-catalog service lost its only serving replica. At 2026-11-17T01:54:12Z the Deployment product-catalog in namespace otel-demo created a new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf whose pod template sets the container command to ["invalid-command"]; every container start since then fails with 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' (StartError, exit 128, 5 restarts, BackOff). The prior healthy ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc was scaled to 0 and its pod stopped at 01:54:21Z, the product-catalog Endpoints object now holds only a notReadyAddress, and the Deployment reports MinimumReplicasUnavailable. Frontend's own error span rate went from 0 at 01:55:00Z to 5.17/s at 01:56:00Z and 16.87/s at 01:59:00Z (the exact value in the alert annotation), concentrated on GET /api/products/{productId} and grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, with the product-catalog-dependent calls of recommendation (/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts) and checkout (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) also failing and frontend-proxy reporting ingress errors. All other otel-demo workloads kept their original ReplicaSets created at 01:24-01:26 and show no error-rate deviation.

claims.text: frontend's error span rate was 0 at 01:55:00Z, then 5.17/s at 01:56:00Z, 16.60/s at 01:57:00Z and 16.87/s at 01:59:00Z, staying in the 14.96-21.85/s range through 02:04:00Z. The 01:59:00Z value 16.866666666666664 matches the alert annotation's 'current' value, and the first non-zero point follows the product-catalog rollout at 01:54:12Z.

At 02:00:00Z frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans by operation were: GET 5.06/s, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 4.29/s, executing api route (pages) /api/products/[productId] 4.29/s, GET /api/products/{productId} 4.29/s, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 0.78/s, executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations 0.78/s, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.47/s, POST 0.47/s, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 0.47/s, and tcp.connect 0.015/s.

The Deployment product-catalog in namespace otel-demo (revision 2, Helm release otel-demo) has pod-template container 'product-catalog' with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog and command set to ["invalid-command"] with null args, i.e. the image entrypoint is overridden by a non-existent executable.

Pod events in otel-demo record Deployment product-catalog 'Scaled up replica set product-catalog-fcf7564cf from 0 to 1' at 01:54:12Z and 'Scaled down replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc from 1 to 0' plus 'Stopping container product-catalog' on pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-wzpwm at 01:54:21Z. Pods product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx and product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l then produced Warning Failed events reading 'failed to create containerd task: ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH', and pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l produced 25 Warning BackOff events between 01:54:34Z and 01:59:44Z.
Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is phase Running but not ready (ready=false), with restartCount 5 and lastState terminated reason StartError, exitCode 128, finishedAt 2026-11-17T01:57:42Z.

Deployment product-catalog's status shows readyReplicas and availableReplicas null with condition Available=False, reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable, message 'Deployment does not have minimum availability.' It is the only Deployment in otel-demo in that state; the other 20 report available=1 and ready=1.

The Endpoints object for Service product-catalog (selector opentelemetry.io/name=product-catalog, port 8080) contains no ready addresses: its subsets hold only notReadyAddresses 100.96.2.148 pointing at pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, so the Service has no serving backend.

Both product-catalog ReplicaSets are owned by Deployment product-catalog (uid 36350ca9-8d92-41fe-9007-09bf2fbcd0d9): product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc created 01:24:11Z with replicas 0, image 2.1.3-product-catalog and no command; and product-catalog-fcf7564cf created 01:54:12Z with replicas 1, ready null, the same image tag and command ["invalid-command"]. The image tag is unchanged, so this is a configuration change to the deployment rather than an image change.

product-catalog-fcf7564cf (01:54:12Z) is the only ReplicaSet in otel-demo created during the incident window; every other workload's active ReplicaSet was created at 01:24:11Z-01:26:15Z. The one other object with a later timestamp, flagd-8556f87d4b at 01:26:15Z, predates the error onset and its predecessor flagd-c47676d99 has 0 replicas.

Downstream services' own error spans at 02:00:00Z are their product-catalog client calls: recommendation '/oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts' 0.78/s and internal 'get_product_list' 0.78/s; checkout 'oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct' 0.47/s and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 0.47/s; frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' 5.59/s and 'ingress' 5.60/s.

Service-level STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rates were 0 through 01:50:00Z for every service, then at 02:00:00Z and 02:05:00Z were frontend 22.16/17.93 per second, frontend-proxy 11.19/9.14, recommendation 1.56/1.39 and checkout 0.94/0.86; accounting, fraud-detection and payment stayed at 0 across the 23:00Z-02:05Z range and ad was 0 until a negligible 0.004 at 02:05:00Z. No product-catalog error series was returned for the window.

fraud-detection pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 restarted once with lastState OOMKilled (exitCode 137, finishedAt 01:44:15Z) and is now ready, but its own error-rate series was 0 at both 02:00:00Z and 02:05:00Z and the restart precedes the error onset and the product-catalog rollout, so it is not tied to this alert.

flagd feature flags as the cause were considered and rejected: the flagd-config ConfigMap shows productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adFailure, cartFailure, paymentFailure and paymentUnreachable all at defaultVariant 'off', and in any case the observed failure is the product-catalog container failing at init ('exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'), before any application code or flag evaluation could run.

The single fault origin is the configuration change applied to Deployment product-catalog at 01:54:12Z that replaced the container entrypoint with command ["invalid-command"], leaving product-catalog with zero serving replicas from 01:54:21Z onward; frontend's frontend-proxy ingress errors and its GetProduct/product-page errors, plus recommendation's ListProducts and checkout's GetProduct errors, are consequences of the product-catalog Service having no ready endpoint. Which actor or automation applied the deployment change is not observable with the available sources.

Roll back Deployment product-catalog (namespace otel-demo) to the previous revision / replica set product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc, which uses the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog without the command override, or remove the command: ["invalid-command"] override from the pod template so the image entrypoint runs; then confirm a ready endpoint appears for Service product-catalog and that frontend, recommendation and checkout error spans return to their pre-01:55 baseline.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so which actor or pipeline applied the product-catalog Deployment update at 01:54:12Z could not be verified.

Jaeger trace search for service frontend over 01:54:00Z-02:05:36Z returned nothing (status no_data), a tag search for error=true on frontend over 01:50:00Z-02:05:36Z also returned nothing (status no_data), and a wider trace search 01:20:00Z-01:54:00Z errored as RESULT_TOO_LARGE with its source window ending at 2026-11-17T01:39:30Z; span-level error payloads for the incident window therefore could not be read, so error attribution rests on Prometheus span metrics rather than traces.

kube-state-metrics series matching kube_deployment_status.*, kube_pod_owner, kube_replicaset_owner and kube_pod_container_info returned no data from Prometheus for 01:00-02:05Z, and the specific query for product-catalog replicas available/ready also returned nothing, so replica availability comes from the Kubernetes API objects rather than from metric history.

Application log reads that returned no data: product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l returned 0 lines with no previous container instance because the container never reached process start; filtered error reads on frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5, recommendation-5f45f75855-xrpch and checkout-5dccddf8bb-8fzjm returned no matching lines, so the runtime failure path in those services is evidenced only by span metrics, not log text. The recommendation log read that did return lines was incomplete (newest 30 of 255 lines).

flagd's runtime flag override state, as opposed to the flagd-config ConfigMap defaults (all 'off'), is not readable with the available tools, so a runtime flag change cannot be fully excluded, though it cannot explain a container init failure.
next_steps: Consult the cluster's change or CI history for the Deployment product-catalog update at 2026-11-17T01:54:12Z (revision 2) to identify the actor and intent behind command: ["invalid-command"].
After rollback or fix, watch the frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate, the frontend-proxy ingress error rate, and product-catalog endpoint readiness to confirm recovery.
Alert on Deployment product-catalog unavailable/ready replica count so a zero-endpoint product-catalog is caught directly rather than only through the frontend error rate.

Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.
